title: Paloma Business Upgrade Incentive Terms
content:
An upgrade incentive is a percentage off the higher plan's part of the proration on a Paloma Business upgrade. It is decided by the payout principal debited from the balance in the three months before the day the proration is settled, counted from the day after the same calendar day three months earlier up to and including that day, and by the whole months since KYB approval.

### Incentive clause

150000.00 USD or more with approval at least 24 whole months earlier earns an upgrade incentive of 25 percent; 60000.00 USD or more with approval at least 12 whole months earlier, not meeting both first-tier conditions, earns 10 percent; anything else earns no upgrade incentive.

The higher plan's part is the higher plan's monthly fee times the share of the period settled, reduced by the upgrade incentive and rounded half up to the cent: the incentive acts before that rounding.

### Combination matrix

| Payout principal debited in the three months | Approved 24 or more whole months earlier | Approved 12 to 23 whole months earlier | Approved fewer than 12 whole months earlier |
|---|---|---|---|
| 150000.00 USD or more | 25 percent | 10 percent | None |
| 60000.00 up to 149999.99 USD | 10 percent | 10 percent | None |
| Below 60000.00 USD | None | None | None |

### Worked figure (hypothetical)

Higher plan's monthly fee 129.00 USD, share settled 0.7, upgrade incentive 10 percent: 129.00 multiplied by 0.7 is 90.30, reduced by 10 percent to 81.27 USD as the higher plan's part. With 21 over 31 as the share settled and an incentive of 25 percent: 129.00 multiplied by 21 over 31 is 87.387..., reduced by 25 percent to 65.540..., rounded half up to 65.54 USD.
